notes: Targets are acceptance criteria, never a claim of installed or verified inventory. Existing 50,000 terms include 47,637 extended index cards. Count independent source-backed entries separately from generated indexes.

simulation_target.note: Currently 50 model families x 100 conditions; a scenario is not an independent simulator. Preserve the core 100 legacy simulations and body laboratory.

integrity_requirements: unique item IDs and source provenance
no fabricated definitions or padded entries
separate detailed content and derived indexes
licence and attribution tracked per dataset
favorites, notes, settings and user SQLite data preserved
visual_requirements: One UI and Fluent inspired, non-identical
light and dark, density, animation and FPS controls
responsive Windows settings and accessible contrast
delivery_requirements: release version and build tag match
